title: Coherent comparisons for exact scalar extension along a tower of sheaf ring objects
statement:
Let $\mathcal S$ be a site small relative to the universe of its abelian sheaves, with the sheaf tensor product of [sk-def-sfb-ring-object]. Let $A\to B\to C\to R$ be morphisms of commutative ring objects in $\Sh(\mathcal S,\Ab)$ [sk-def-sfb-ring-object]. Write $\Mod_A$ for the module-object category of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and similarly for the other rings. For any ordered pair of rings in this tower, including a composite map, let $T_{A,B}=B\otimes_A-$ be the extension of scalars defined by the coequalizer in [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars].

There are canonical natural isomorphisms
$$
 a_{A,B,C,M}:T_{B,C}T_{A,B}M\xrightarrow{\sim}T_{A,C}M
$$
whose morphism on local pure tensors is $c\otimes(b\otimes m)\mapsto c\,b\otimes m$, with $b$ mapped to $C$, and whose inverse sends $c\otimes m$ to $c\otimes(1\otimes m)$. These isomorphisms, for all sub-towers, satisfy the equality
$$
 a_{A,C,R,M}\circ T_{C,R}(a_{A,B,C,M})
 =a_{A,B,R,M}\circ a_{B,C,R,T_{A,B}M}
$$
from $T_{C,R}T_{B,C}T_{A,B}M$ to $T_{A,R}M$, with the functor-composition associators understood. For an identity ring map the comparisons agree with the unit identification $A\otimes_A M\cong M$, whose map is the action.

Assume furthermore that all the module categories here are abelian and that every scalar-extension functor in this tower, including along composite maps, is exact. On their unbounded derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], let $\mathbb T_{A,B}=D(T_{A,B})$ be the functor obtained by applying scalar extension termwise and localizing. The termwise maps $a$ induce natural isomorphisms $\mathbb a_{A,B,C}:\mathbb T_{B,C}\mathbb T_{A,B}\cong\mathbb T_{A,C}$ satisfying the same displayed equality and identity compatibilities. The same comparisons and equalities restrict to any full subcategories preserved by these functors.
